title: Is mall world an opportunity to get our toes wet in the world of vivid dreams

classification.theory_summary: Mall World as an introductory/starting realm that expands over time into broader vivid/astral-like dream settings as the dreamer realizes it is a real place.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream scene descriptions (no specific locations, sensory qualities, entities, interactions, or spatial layout); primarily a theory about progression/expansion of settings over time.

meta.author_theory: Mall World functions as an introduction/training ground for later expanded vivid/astral-like dreams; over time the "map expands" and settings diversify, especially after realizing it feels like a "true real place" rather than a regular dream.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to meta-level statements: (1) recurring Mall World dreams over an extended period ("a year" given as an example, not confirmed personal duration), (2) a recent gap in visiting the mall location ("not been to the mall itself in a few weeks"), and (3) continued vivid dreams in "way different settings" without description. No extractable per-location sensory/atmospheric details.
